relations.notes: Vishnu Purana 1.15 names Aditi among Daksha's daughters. This Puranic relationship remains separate from the reciprocal Rigvedic cosmogony.

sources.reference: Vishnu Purana 1.15, Wilson translation, p.122: daughters married to Kasyapa

relations.notes: The passage calls Marichi one of Brahman's six spiritual sons; this is not biological generation.

sources.reference: Mahabharata Adi Parva LXVI, Ganguli translation, opening spiritual-sons passage
